checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.”

must.why: Dark bold text on light background, with margins on both sides.

must.item: Steaming espresso on sunlit café table
must.why: White cup with steam on a sunlit table, blurred café background.

faults.what: The cup is a bit large and the coffee surface is wide for an espresso. It looks more like a regular coffee cup.

summary: A clean, warm square image of a steaming cup on a sunlit table, with the headline spelled correctly and clearly readable; the only flaws are minor (cup size and low resolution).
